propers.name: Collect
propers.incipit: Deus, qui beatae Mariae Virginis domum

mass_before.notes: ANTECEDENT, NOT THE CONTROLLING EDITION. This Latin was read on 2026-08-20 from the PAGE IMAGE of leaf n782, n783 (printed [113], [114]) of Internet Archive item bub_gb_E7sPAAAAIAAJ, the Pustet Ratisbon 1862 printing of the Missale Romanum, at the day heading Die x. In Festo Translationis Almae Domus B. M. V., and not from any optical text layer. That printing attests its own 1862 `pro aliquibus locis` appendix recension. It does not attest the Missale Romanum, editio typica tertia 2002/2008, which this file declares as its edition, which is in copyright and is not held here. Whether the 2002 Missal appoints this same prayer on this day is an editorial determination that has NOT been made. Accents and ae/oe ligatures are normalized to this file's declared orthography. Nothing here has been collated; the entry stands in open_collation_items.

propers.notes: The official2019 Latin annex supplies one own Collect for the10December optional memorial; its complete body was privately inspected and is withheld pending an independent publication basis. It differs materially from the old1862HolyHouse Collect. The whole source was acquired and hashed; neither acquisition nor official status supplies republication permission. Complete-as-printed means its actual abbreviated conclusion cue is held; no expanded spoken ending has been established or supplied.

mass_after.notes: The decree dated 7 October 2019 and its annex published 31 October 2019 establish the optional memorial on 10 December. The Missale Romanum annex gives a broader direction to the Common of the Blessed Virgin Mary and prints one own Collect. The schema represents only the antiphon subset in common_from; the broader source direction is preserved here. Remaining lawful choices are unresolved in this bounded correction. No Common form is selected. The old three-prayer entry, consisting of incipits and typed gaps rather than Latin bodies, and all three previous English gap dictionaries are preserved verbatim in the superseded receipt. The distinct OLM annex, n. 689 bis, at HTML lines 178-190 gives First Reading, Responsorial Psalm, Gospel Acclamation and Gospel roles. Those appointments remain unrepresented and inactive here. The unrepresented reading appointments are a separate Lectionary gap. The partial missal-formulary status concerns only unresolved Missal material and choices.

common_from.locus: Official2019 Latin Missale Romanum annex:10December; De Communi beatae Mariae Virginis; entire Common direction precedes ownCollect

gap_after.note: The official 2019 bulletin supplies the Latin own Collect, complete as printed with its abbreviated conclusion cue. It supplies no English prayer witness. The prior historical Holy House refusal dictionaries and fingerprints remain verbatim in the superseded receipt. No complete spoken Latin ending is reconstructed.

superseded_prior_gaps.note: THE WITNESS DOES NOT PRINT THIS DAY. Read on the 1861 page images on 2026-08-20: leaf n538 (printed p. 530) carries the Mass of `VIII. CONCEPTION of the B. V. M.`, and leaf n539 (printed p. 531, running head `11th AND 13th DECEMBER.`) carries that Mass's end and then `XI. St. DAMASUS, p. c.` There is no 10 December formulary between them. The 1862 prints this Mass only in its `pro aliquibus locis` appendix, which the 1861 lay missal does not carry. Nothing is carried. Incipit of the Latin refused here: `Deus, qui beatae Mariae Virginis domum`. Read on the page image https://archive.org/download/romanmissaltran00churgoog/page/n539_w1400.jpg (leaf n539, printed p. 531, heading `11th AND 13th DECEMBER.`) by lane pc-antecedent-english on 2026-08-20. The later unofficial-web rows were rejected as authoritative exemplars; their wording was quarantined and is represented only by the SHA-256 fingerprint above.
